description: Rise: the conjectured climb from the Razborov–Lo crease to the regular (Lo) minimizer — complete multipartite (t−1 full parts + 2 small parts) with the small pair thinned, swept from the crease to the regular point.
provenance: rise scallop t=2: 2 special parts s + 1 full parts a=(1-2s)/1 joined at density p; parameterized by (edge d∈[0.5000,0.6667], sweep λ∈[0,1]) so rows lie at constant edge — λ=0 crease (d1=c*(d), d3=Razborov), λ=1 Lo (d3=g(d), δ2=d²); s interpolated, p=(d-1+4s²+(1-2s)²/1)/(2s²). Conjectured (conj:edge-triangle-regular).
